# #267 — Add graph-powered relational retrieval arm to search_brain

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: enhancement
Created: 2026-07-07T22:10:40Z
Updated: 2026-07-08T01:06:53Z
Closed: 2026-07-08T01:06:53Z

---

## Problem

Open Brain stores graph links, and `adjacent_context` can read them, but `search_brain` currently chooses results from vector + keyword retrieval before links are attached as metadata. That means links do not help answer relational questions.

Sprint: #265.
Paired with: #266.

## Scope

Add a bounded, namespace-safe relational retrieval arm over existing `ob_entities` / `ob_links` and inject its hydrated results into the existing `search_brain` fusion path.

## Proposed shape

- Parse only a small allowlisted set of relational query patterns.
- Resolve seed entities inside readable namespaces only.
- Traverse existing `ob_links` with a bounded depth and limit.
- Hydrate linked rows into normal `SearchRow`-compatible evidence with source refs.
- Add the graph arm to hybrid RRF only when the parser fires and seeds resolve.
- Fail open: graph errors should log/degrade, not break ordinary search.
- Keep keyword/vector behavior unchanged for non-relational queries.

## Acceptance criteria

- Uses the existing graph schema; no new graph store.
- Enforces namespace/read policy for seed resolution, traversal, and hydrated output.
- Excludes archived links/entities.
- Adds telemetry/meta enough to know whether the relational arm fired, candidate count, and failures.
- Paired eval issue passes: relational lift proven, non-relational no-regression proven.
- `search_all` and `brain_answer` behavior remains unchanged unless explicitly wired by follow-up issues.

## Validation expectation

- Focused search/graph tests.
- New relational eval gate.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit`.
- Relevant existing `search-brain`, `search-all`, and namespace tests.

## Non-goals

- No recursive arbitrary-depth traversal.
- No LLM parser.
- No UI graph view.
- No NATS/fleet-bus work.
